_comment: Which source font renders which .ffu. Sizes are auto-fitted to each template's uppercase height, so no px values are needed here. Paths are relative to the repo root.

window/font/advfont1.ffu.note: in-game font option I; stroke ratio 2.43

window/font/advfont2.ffu.note: in-game font option II; stroke ratio 2.00
